source.name: FDA panel votes down Intarcia's twice-rejected, long-term diabetes drug implant

evidence.snippet: The FDA's Endocrinologic and Metabolic Drugs Advisory Committee voted unanimously (19-0) against ITCA 650 (exenatide in the DUROS/Medici osmotic implant device) on Sept 21, 2023, citing acute kidney injury and cardiovascular safety concerns; the FDA subsequently issued a final decision refusing to approve the NDA, effective Aug 23, 2024 (Federal Register).
